MEASURED 2026-11-19, three windows (2-min spot check, two 10-min runs): camera subsystem 2666-2898 mW at V=3.87. Marked NOT_APPLICABLE rather than FAIL because the camera line covers sensor+ISP+encode, i.e. the cost of running the camera at all, NOT the incremental cost of our inference - a 500 mW bar is below what a phone camera costs to merely switch on. Per-process attribution is unavailable on this device: dumpsys battery has no 'current now', sysfs reads are denied to shell, and batterystats has no per-uid entry for the app. The model's own cost is measured separately: classifiers 3.4-4.8 ms/clip, detector 34-45 ms/frame on GPU. So the honest answer is NOT MEASURABLE FOR THE MODEL ALONE, bounded by ~2.9 W for the whole camera path. docs/POWER_THERMAL_2026-11-19.md
